dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge exhibits a slight concave curvature (falcate) transitioning to a steeper slope near the basal insertion point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphology with a medium pixel radius at the highest vertical point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Anterior margin displays a gradual incline approximately 35-40 degrees relative to the horizontal dorsal midline.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Estimated 1.7:1 ratio of the longitudinal base chord to the maximum vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Shallow, low-profile convexity with a large radius curve transitioning smoothly from the blowhole region.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short and robust pixel length with significant relative thickness compared to the total cranial length.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse, poorly defined interior angle at the transition point between the melon and the rostrum.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible irregular notch/indentation on the lower posterior margin of the dorsal fin; multiple small, circular white depigmentation marks and punctate lesions across the mid-lateral flank.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced mottling and white speckling pattern distributed across the dark gray epidermis.
